name: Report a change that affects your benefits
description: Claimant reports a change of circumstances. Recent changes can be reported by phone; older changes need a written explanation and evidence shown in person.
descriptionPublic: Tell DWP straight away if something changes that could affect your benefits, such as moving home, a change in income, or someone moving in or out.

steps.name: When did the change happen?
steps.description: The number of days since the change decides whether it can be reported by phone or needs a written report.

fields.name: days_since_change
fields.label: How many days ago did the change happen?
fields.hint: Enter a whole number of days.

type.callCharges: Free from personal mobiles and landlines.

steps.name: Call the helpline to report the change
steps.description: Recent changes are taken over the phone.

steps.name: Write to report the change
steps.description: A late change needs a written explanation of what changed and when.

fields.name: change_explanation
fields.label: What changed, and the date it changed

steps.name: Take your evidence to the jobcentre
steps.description: A late change is confirmed in person with original documents.

fields.name: evidence_document
fields.label: Evidence of the change
fields.hint: Bring the original document, for example a tenancy agreement or a payslip.

type.body: We will review the change and write to you if your payments change. Keep reporting any further changes as they happen.
